pages: G.O.(Rt)No.1217/2025/PWD GOVERNMENT OF KERALA PUBLIC WORKS (G) DEPARTMENT. Administrative Sanction was accorded for the work Construction of Retaining wall @ KM 6/400 and providing 20mm bit CC to Panikankudi Kombodinjal Ponmudi Road at Km 0/000 to 8/000 km in Idukki LAC for an estimated amount of Rs. 350 Crores under the H/A 3054-03-337-97 in Idukki LAC vide Government Order read as 1st paper above. The Chief Engineer, PWD Roads Division, Thiruvananthapuram has requested to accord Revised Administrative Sanction for the work Construction of Retaining wall @ KM 6/400 and providing 20mm bit CC to Panikankudi Kombodinjal Ponmudi Road at Km 0/000 to 8/000 km in Idukki LAC Rs. 689 Crores under the H/A 3054-03-337-97 in Idukki LAC.

G.O.(Rt)No.1217/2025/PWD. Government have examined the matter in detail and are pleased to accord Revised Administrative Sanction for the work Construction of Retaining wall @ Km 6/400 and providing 20mm bit CC to Panikkankudi Kombodinjal Ponmudi Road at Km 0/000 to 8/000 for an amount of Rs 260 Lakhs, for the modified proposal subject to the following conditions.

amendment.scope_quote: The Government Order read above stands modified to this extent only.
